verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a single human approval gate: no agent work runs until a person approves a task contract. It explicitly calls approval 'the only gate', so there is no evidence of configurable tiered autonomy levels. The opt-in failure threshold for PR checks is an adjacent control on review results, not on what an agent may do without confirmation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation

citations.quote: Nothing runs until a person approves a contract. Approval is the only gate
